scope: synthetic household engineering checks, not psychological validation
checks: multiple independent private-context replies use previously received speech
elapsed response intervals resolve intended turns and account both participants
same-room bystanders overhear and acquire received affect
explicit adjoining-room audibility does not establish firsthand acquaintance
closed-room person receives no conversation memory or mood update
spoken allegations never become canonical facts
speakers always see their own received turns of the current conversation and the end of the previous same-topic session, regardless of retrieval rank; bystanders and non-participants get none
a near-repeat of the speaker's own recent words is re-asked once with the earlier words shown; a second repeat is kept, never fatal; short replies are exempt
repetition reaches the listener's situation construal; their own model-written repetition signature (one is required) then shapes the decision and temporary state
a listener's appraisal links a question to the same person's earlier one; the running count reaches later decisions as irritation for anyone; links to unreceived memories are rejected
identical routine observations reuse the person's own recent full appraisal without a model call, habituating as 1/(1+n); new, non-routine or stale (30-day) ones get a full appraisal
a situation with room and hours occurs only while the actor is there within the hours; out-of-window occurrences are postponed, and skipped after 14 tries at an unreachable place
face-to-face turns use in_person_response_minutes; response_minutes stays the written-channel delay

a researcher line from the inbox waits for an active conversation, is heard by participants and room listeners (not closed rooms), uses no turn, is delivered once, persists its offset, and appears in the watcher feed
agent environment context reveals only same-room presence, never private profiles or remote locations

a researcher phone call rings the person, who decides to answer or let it ring; mid-conversation they step away and come back, the room hears only their side, an unknown caller stays unknown, asleep means a missed call, silence ends it

a sent character is your own persistent agent (introduced by --who on first meeting) that remembers both sides; you type its lines or the model plays it toward a goal, typing takes it back, /auto hands it over, hanging up recalls it; world people cannot be puppeted; you can later ask your character how it went

face to face, each researcher line gets the person's own reply turn (speak, stay quiet or end) with the exchange so far; they step aside from a group conversation and come back, the room sees the visitor arrive and leave, asleep means no meeting; a later visit brings the person's memories of the visitor to the top of recall (person-cued)

two people with the same name get distinct @handles and are perceived as "Priya (@priya0123)"; the bare name stays ambiguous for testimony while an @handle resolves; duplicate handles are rejected; worlds without handles are unchanged
JSON and SQLite restore locations, received turns, calendar and conversation state
mid-response checkpoint resumes identically without replaying completed events or time accounting
failed bystander appraisal rolls back turn, action, calendars and all recipients; retry commits once
unavailable invited participant cannot be forced into a conversation
response interval cannot cross the end of a waking window
calendar commitments prevent double-booked conversation participation
movement during a response cancels speech before it is delivered
death during a response prevents posthumous speech
independently chosen departure changes physical routing and ends an undersized conversation
infant conversation participation is nonverbal with no adult plan
invalid physical policy is rejected before runtime mutation
archived policies remain free of implicit rooms or invented conversations
daily availability also gates ordinary elapsed activity reservations
silent action contracts reject contradictory model speech
resolved dialogue actions feed existing developmental exposure gates; overhearing alone does not count as enacted behavior
explicit room contact cannot begin with a remotely located person
physical contact activity cannot resolve after a participant leaves its room
